research_question: Can an extreme five-minute directional auction be separated before entry into deleveraging exhaustion versus new-position acceptance by using base open-interest change and an independent confirmation bar?

scenario.context: abnormal five-minute futures return, quote volume and directional taker pressure

state.DELEVERAGING_EXHAUSTION: base open interest falls abnormally during the event, identifying position destruction rather than merely a large candle
state.POSITION_BUILDUP_ACCEPTANCE: base open interest rises abnormally during the event, identifying new directional risk formation
state.UNRESOLVED: ordinary OI change or contradictory flow is no-trade

confirmation.DELEVERAGING_EXHAUSTION: the next completed five-minute bar stops extending, OI stops collapsing and taker pressure opposes the event; trade reversal after that close
confirmation.POSITION_BUILDUP_ACCEPTANCE: the next completed bar extends, OI does not unwind, composite index follows, peers agree and taker pressure remains aligned; trade continuation after that close

scenario.invalidation_target_note: This is an economic mechanism screen. A surviving route must use the event extreme as invalidation and causal liquidity/index objectives in NautilusTrader.

data.price_source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly futures klines plus indexPriceKlines
data.metrics_visibility: native five-minute create_time; joined only at or after the observation timestamp

evaluation.overlap_policy: no new selected episode while the selected route horizon is active

decision_contract.advance: Only a route/router passing development, untouched evaluation, costs, stability and frequency is frozen for NautilusTrader.
decision_contract.reject: Do not tune these thresholds after seeing evaluation. Preserve only an independently positive route and move to another causal family.
